collection.basis: Karim's decision of 8 Nov 2026, replacing the delegated one of 7 Nov: the site is for him alone, so sources are collected even where their terms forbid it, as long as every row keeps its licence and rights (evidence.data_rights). Anti-bot checks, logins and other technical barriers are still never bypassed, and nothing from these sites enters the public repository (A22).

publication.basis: Karim's decision of 8 Nov 2026: he is the only person with access, so the site shows every collected source with its rights. Switch this on, or replace the sources (B14), before anyone else sees the platform: user sessions, public opening (A22).
